SELECT d.id, d.dict_type_id, d.dict_label, d.dict_value, d.i18n_key, d.attr_type, d.remark, d.sort, d.updated_by, d.updated_at, d.created_by, d.created_at FROM sys_dict_data d
d.dict_type_id = #{dictTypeId}
AND d.dict_label like concat('%', #{dictLabel}, '%')
AND d.dict_value like concat('%', #{dictValue}, '%')
ORDER BY d.sort ASC
